status: Exploratory independent post hoc robustness audit; fixed before executing new analysis
scope: No shared analysis or manuscript is modified. Source processed counts and metadata are read directly.
provenance: Check hashes, STAR integer values and technical-replicate sums, source/RFID accounting, and cached gene-family BH results.
ground_association: All 400 assignments of 3 versus 3 cohort labels in each age block, including observed; each assignment rebuilds all 81 balanced train8/test4 holdouts and supervised contrast weights. Training-only filtering and normalization are cached by animal training set, independently of labels. Fixed eight inherited panels plus whole-genome contrast comparator are retained in both core regions, forming 18 exact permutation tests in one audit family. Statistic: mean held-out within-age pair discrimination; positive orientation learned from the corresponding training labels.
ground_inference: Exact finite label-enumeration probability conditional on within-age exchangeability; observational cohort inference. Overlapping splits are aggregated once within each label assignment; no split-level independence assumption. BH and BY sensitivity supplied.
age_check: All eight inherited panels in both core regions, full-data and existing animal conflict exclusions. Estimate younger and older difference-in-differences directly from cell means and equal-age-standardized mean where all cells exist. Also fit unrestricted three-way age x flight x collection models on full data, with HC3 uncertainty; no new favored-significance gene scan.
risk_decomposition: Independently reconstruct all existing 362 ground holdouts; verify original outside-sensor MSE ratios. Report per-animal repeated-holdout summaries, training-expression tertiles, fraction of outside genes with worse prediction, and rank-one prediction risk decomposition. No independent-sample confidence interval from repeated splits. No target-based tuning.
claim_boundary: This audit cannot guarantee novelty, causal microgravity effects, biological recovery, external population generalization, or journal acceptance. Complete negative results are retained.
